column9: ON = an idle+sleep inhibitor is held, hypridle skips dim, screensaver and panel-off. Waybar shows the remaining time.

column3: Keep awake while this window is open
column9: Released when the window that was focused before the hub opened closes.

column3: Keep working with the lid closed
column9: ON = closing the lid does not suspend. With an external monitor the lid only turns the laptop panel off.
tlp-pd profile. Needs the tlp-pd package and service.
Laptop panel: brightnessctl/swayosd. External monitor: ddcutil over DDC/CI (needs ddcutil and the i2c group).
Units, currency and dates via libqalculate; Enter copies the result.
Edit ~/.config/snippets/snippets.tsv. Variables: date, time, datetime, clipboard.
